title: tozzia alpina subsp. carpathica
intro: Tozzia alpina subsp. carpathica, commonly known as Carpathian tozzia, is a plant species belonging to the family Gesneriaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Carpathian tozzia include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which are beneficial for soothing respiratory tract infections and promoting overall well-being. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
